mapper.insert: insert into stock_tail_recommend_run (trade_date, rule_version, candidate_count, hit_count, picked_count, reject_summary, create_time) values (#{tradeDate}, #{ruleVersion}, #{candidateCount}, #{hitCount}, #{pickedCount}, #{rejectSummary}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update candidate_count = values(candidate_count), hit_count = values(hit_count), picked_count = values(picked_count), reject_summary = values(reject_summary)
